g.text: Objective: get each new analysis sidecar onto master, where the site workflow picks it up; nothing else from this checkout is committed.

text.tspan: reports/YYYY-MM-DD/analysis/TICKER.json
one per company and analysis day
scripts/weekly.sh, runs the publish script
only when every step before it succeeded
the analysis sidecar (its JSON file) is written
bot analyze writes it under reports/
the publish script finds the sidecar
find reports/*/analysis/*.json
none found: exit 0, nothing is published
the sidecar is copied into a clean checkout of master
detached worktree .cache/site-publish, reset to origin/master and cleaned on every run;
only the sidecars are copied in
the commit is made
git add -- reports
commit message chore(site): publish analyses YYYY-MM-DD
nothing new to publish
nothing staged: no commit, exit 0
the push is refused
exit 1; the next run rebuilds the commit from origin/master
the sidecar is on master
the push to origin master succeeded

g.text: the workflow stops with an error

text.tspan: Comes out:
one commit on master that holds only reports/*/analysis/*.json

g.text: the script copies the sidecar into a clean checkout of master
the script finds nothing to commit [the sidecar is already on master]
the push fails [master refuses it or cannot be reached]
the site continuous integration (CI) workflow starts and installs the dependencies
the install fails [a dependency cannot be installed]
